strategy.title: Extraction strategy
strategy.description: auto: tries direct HTTP fetch first (fastest, no subprocess), falls back to yt-dlp. direct: direct only. ytdlp: yt-dlp only (most compatible).

preferredLanguage.title: Preferred transcript languages (ordered)
preferredLanguage.description: Example: ["en", "en-US"]. Defaults to English if omitted.

paragraphMode.title: Paragraph mode
paragraphMode.description: Groups segments into paragraphs based on silence gaps. Outputs double-newline between paragraphs.

paragraphBreakSecs.title: Paragraph break threshold (seconds)
paragraphBreakSecs.description: Minimum silence gap that triggers a new paragraph when paragraphMode is true.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: text_and_segments also includes the segments array with per-cue timing.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: srt: also adds srtContent field with numbered subtitle blocks and timestamps.

includeStats.title: Include transcript statistics
includeStats.description: Adds stats object: wordCount, charCount, segmentCount, coveredSec, wordsPerMinute, estimatedReadingTimeSec.

saveVttToKV.title: Save raw VTT to Key-Value Store
